stories.title: Gemeentehuis Rhenen beschadigd na vergadering over asielopvang, ME ingezet

en.title: Rhenen town hall damaged after meeting on asylum reception, riot police deployed
en.summary: The town hall in Rhenen was damaged by fireworks following a municipal council meeting about asylum seeker accommodation. Two windows were broken and riot police were called to manage the unrest.

stories.title: Amerikaanse vrouw nog in leven tijdens executie met dodelijke injecties

en.title: American woman still alive during lethal injection execution
en.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court allowed Christa Pike's execution to proceed despite an initial delay. According to her lawyer, Pike survived two lethal injections and was taken to a hospital.

stories.title: Zwitserse gletsjers krompen ‘schokkend’ snel in snikhete zomer

en.title: Swiss glaciers shrunk 'shockingly' fast during extremely hot summer
en.summary: Swiss glaciers experienced exceptionally rapid shrinkage during an unusually hot summer period.

stories.title: Laatste grote hobbel weg voor overname Warner Bros. door Paramount

en.title: Final major hurdle removed for Paramount's acquisition of Warner Bros.
en.summary: A U.S. judge approved a settlement between twelve states and Paramount Skydance, clearing the last significant legal obstacle to Paramount's takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery. Paramount agreed to invest an additional 300 million dollars annually in film production over five years.

stories.title: Executie Christa Pike mag van Hooggerechtshof doorgaan, media melden dat ze nog leeft

en.title: High Court allows execution of Christa Pike to proceed, media report she is still alive
en.summary: A high court has authorized the execution of Christa Pike to continue, while media outlets report that the death row inmate remains alive following the procedure.

stories.title: ME ingezet in Rhenen na vernieling met vuurwerk bij gemeentehuis

en.title: Riot police deployed in Rhenen after fireworks damage to municipal building
en.summary: Windows at the Rhenen municipal building were damaged with fireworks following a council meeting about asylum seeker accommodations. Police presence was increased after an unannounced demonstration earlier that evening.

stories.title: Rechter maakt weg vrij voor overname Warner Bros. door Paramount

en.title: Judge clears path for Paramount's takeover of Warner Bros.
en.summary: A judge has removed legal obstacles allowing Paramount to proceed with acquiring Warner Bros.

stories.title: Amerikaanse media: Christa Pike nog in leven ondanks dodelijke injecties

en.title: US media: Christa Pike still alive despite lethal injections
en.summary: The 50-year-old death row inmate in Tennessee remains conscious with a heartbeat following two lethal injections, according to journalists and her attorney present at the facility.

stories.title: Premier Burnham bevestigt: sterke aanwijzingen dat Iran betrokken was bij de mogelijke aanslag op een militaire basis in Engeland

en.title: Premier Burnham confirms: strong indications that Iran was involved in possible attack on military base in England
en.summary: Five men were arrested near a military base in Fairford last weekend. Premier Burnham indicates strong evidence suggesting Iranian involvement in a potential attack at the location.

stories.title: Schrijver en cabaretier Paulien Cornelisse (50) overleden

en.title: Writer and cabaret performer Paulien Cornelisse (50) deceased
en.summary: Dutch writer and cabaret performer Paulien Cornelisse died at age 50 from cancer at a hospital in Amsterdam. She was known for her books, theater performances, and documentaries, including her bestselling work from 2009.

stories.title: Schrijfster en cabaretière Paulien Cornelisse (50) overleden

en.title: Writer and cabaret performer Paulien Cornelisse (50) deceased
en.summary: Writer and cabaret performer Paulien Cornelisse died at age 50 from cancer at a hospital in Amsterdam on Wednesday.

stories.title: Paulien Cornelisse (50) overleden: veelzijdig verzamelaar van observaties over gedrag en taal

en.title: Paulien Cornelisse (50) deceased: versatile collector of observations about behavior and language
en.summary: Dutch performer and artist Paulien Cornelisse has died at age 50. She was known for her diverse work collecting and analyzing observations about human behavior and language.
